run_metaquery_pipeline: run the MetaQueryPipeline to generate images from a text caption with configurable inference steps
run_metaquery_image_to_image: run the MetaQueryPipeline with an input image to perform image-to-image generation with guidance scales
run_metaquery_negative_prompt: run the MetaQueryPipeline with a negative prompt to exclude unwanted features from generated images
review_metaquerypipelineoutput: review the MetaQueryPipelineOutput dataclass that holds generated images as PIL Images or numpy arrays
review_metaquery_call: review the MetaQueryPipeline call method that supports text and image inputs with configurable generation parameters
